noisy-accented.transcript: Good morning, this is pre-Irugune of the calling from Cubanites platform engineering at Centrics Biologics. Our quarterly revenue came in at $47,300, which is about 12% below the Q3 forecast. The main issue was latency on the post-GRSQL replica in Frankfurt, where page 99 responds times hit 800 milleccans. Siappon from the Dublin office suggested we migrate the idempotency keys to a distant enabled vector for the semantic search index. Before Thursday's board meeting, please confirm three things. First, the SOC-2 audit window closes on November 9. Second, the anticoagulant trial data from Massachusetts General must be dead identified under HIPAA. Third, Goyancy fan will present the Lama fine-tuning results, including the Laura Doctor Benchmark. If anything slips, ping me on Slack or call extension 44419. Thanks, and let's keep the momentum going.
